pilot.visible_output: A deterministic static HTML/CSS/JS browser page representing the first Kubernetes-game vertical slice.

target.goal: Bootstrap a separate, deterministic static browser application that can later be changed under explicit human authority without coupling its product lifecycle to Promptbranch's own release lifecycle.

requirements: The application lives in a repository distinct from the Promptbranch control-plane repository.
The first vertical slice has a deterministic visible browser output.
Application architecture and authority boundaries are explicit.
Application-specific tests are deterministic and declared before mutation.
Mutation, Git publication, Project Source mutation, artifact acceptance, and deployment remain disabled in the bootstrap slice.
A rollback contract is required before any later repository mutation.
